<!-- FORGE:INVESTIGATOR -->
## Investigation Report

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Confirmed |
| Confidence | High |
| Severity | Medium |
| Task Type | Correctness / Recovery |

### What Was Claimed

An interrupted parent merge can leave a durable `merge` effect while `merge-1` remains running. Attach first restores `workflow:merged`, but parent-node resume can project `workflow:awaiting-merge` and later error, overwriting the durable terminal label.

### What We Found

The current recovery path calls `#reconcileWorkflowProjection` and then resumes a persisted parent node. `#runParentNode` projects the generic `merge`-started stage before reading current durable state. A running merge therefore maps to `awaitingMerge` even when `state.effects` already contains the committed merge receipt. If the resumed merge call fails, the catch path unconditionally rolls the label back to `workflow:in-review`.

### Root Cause

Workflow-stage derivation and merge-failure compensation use only the transient node transition. They do not give the authoritative durable merge effect precedence, so a lower-confidence recovery transition can overwrite terminal merge evidence.

### Affected Files

| File | Reason |
| --- | --- |
| `src/workflows/work-on.ts` | Parent-node recovery, workflow-stage reconciliation, and merge-failure compensation need durable-effect precedence. |
| `test/workflows/work-on.test.ts` | Focused restart/projection regression coverage is required. |

### Evidence

- `#reconcileWorkflowProjection` derives a running latest merge node as `workflowStageForNodeTransition("merge", "started")`, which is `awaitingMerge`.
- `#runParentNode` projects the same generic started transition before reading current durable run state.
- The merge side effect is durably recorded before completion of the merge node.
- The merge catch path always calls `rollbackAwaitingMergeLabel`, which projects `workflow:in-review`.

### History Findings

Issue `#147` was generated from correctness finding `CORRECTNESS-001` on PR `#145` at reviewed head `62a9b270a121ced818a68d57db622f05a59de290`. The current integration base still contains the vulnerable transition ordering and compensation logic.

### Recommendation

Introduce one durable-state stage selector that prioritizes any recorded merge effect as `merged`, use it both during attach reconciliation and parent-node restart projection, and make merge-failure compensation preserve `workflow:merged` when the current snapshot already contains the durable merge receipt. Add regression tests covering both recovery projections and the failure compensation path.

### Related Issues

- Source issue `#119`
- Source PR `#145`

### Decomposition Assessment

No decomposition is required. The fix is bounded to merge recovery projection semantics and focused tests.

### Acceptance Spec

- [ ] **AC-1** — A durable merge effect takes precedence over a running merge node during attach reconciliation.
- [ ] **AC-2** — Resuming the persisted parent merge node does not downgrade the merged workflow stage.
- [ ] **AC-3** — A resumed merge failure preserves the merged label when durable merge evidence exists, while ordinary pre-effect failures still roll back to review.
- [ ] **AC-4** — `npm run check` passes.

<!-- INVESTIGATION:COMPLETE -->
